title: Project Assistant
description:
**Project Assistant – Funded Research Project \| Department of Physics, PDEU** 




  





 The Department of Physics, Pandit Deendayal Energy University (PDEU), Gandhinagar, invites applications for one Project Assistant under a 3\-year research project funded by the Climate Change Department, Government of Gujarat.
 



  





**Project Title:** 



* Next\-Generation Ambient CO₂ Sensors for Energy\-Efficient Climate Mitigation in Gujarat



  





**Role Description** 




 This is a full\-time, on\-site Project Assistant role based at the PDEU campus in Gandhinagar. The Project Assistant will support project planning and execution (literature review, methodolgy, synthesis, characterisations, fabrication, sensor optimisation and its electronics etc.) including coordinating activities, maintaining documentation, and tracking timelines and deliverables.
 



 Responsibilities include assisting with data collection and analysis, preparing reports and presentations, and supporting communication between faculty and other stakeholders. The role also involves organizing project meetings and events, handling basic administrative tasks related to projects, and ensuring compliance with university procedures. The Project Assistant is expected to collaborate closely with project leads to help achieve project objectives efficiently.
 



  





**Eligibility:** 




  




* M.Sc. in Physics, Applied Physics, Materials Science or Electronics with ≥55% marks/CGPA equivalent;



 OR
 


* 4\-Year B.Sc. in relevant disciplines with ≥75% marks/CGPA equivalent.



  





 Experience/exposure in materials synthesis and characterization, electronics, circuit development or PCB designing will be desirable.
 



  





  





**Position** 
 : Project Assistant \| 01 Post
 



**Fellowship** 
 : ₹25,000/month
 



**Initial Duration:** 
 12 months, extendable up to 3 years based on project requirements and performance.
 



**Last Date to Apply:** 
 04 October 2026
 



**Tentative Interview:** 
 06 October 2026
 



  





*Interested candidates should send their CV to* 
***Abhishek.Gor@sot.pdpu.ac.in***
*.* 




  





 📌 Please refer to the poster for complete details and terms \& conditions.
 



  





 🌐 PDEU Careers: https://pdeu.ac.in/careers
 



  





 🎓 Selected candidates may also pursue Ph.D. registration at PDEU, subject to the prevailing University eligibility, admission and selection criteria.

title: Team Leader
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We’re devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone. We hire individuals with a broad range of backgrounds and experiences and invest heavily in our teammates and their families by offering competitive benefits to support their physical, emotional, and financial well\-being.
   

  

 Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees. We use a multi\-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization.
   

  

 Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview**
 As part of Global Ops Change Group, the incumbent will be an integral part of a multi\-disciplinary team whose mandate will be to deliver industry leading Front\-to\-Back process and technology solutions. Acting as a change agent, he/she will manage a variety of value\-driven initiatives at every phase of the project life cycle. Use his/her knowledge of processes and best practices within technology (application integration / application development), Finance/Middle\-Office Operations and project management to assist in identification, assessment, and resolution of complex issues/problems.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Assist in executing the enterprise\-wide direction for GBAM Ops functions. As a member in the group, he/she will support front\-to\-back integration and change initiatives and be accountable for driving change and executing successful implementations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 As a member of DROM Transformation and Change Management team within Global Operations responsibilities will include the following:
   

  

 Candidate will have to liaise with relevant stakeholders (Business, Legal, Compliance, Operations \& Technology etc.) to analyze and decipher key Business requirements and assist in driving the End\-to\-End Project plan
   

  

 Help with defining project scope and perform change assessment
   

  

 Will be expected to prepare BRD, Business scenarios, Traceability matrix, Run books and other key project artefacts at various stages of the project life cycle
   

  

 He/she should be able to manage or assure any risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies that can impact the Go\-live
   

  

 Candidate will have the opportunity to plan \& manage end to end project/ UAT on behalf of Operations for medium to large sized projects
   

  

 Will be expected to create UAT plan, define test approach, co\-ordinate environment readiness discussions with technology teams, drive defect management and UAT governance routines
   

  

 Manage and execute deliverables specific to the region as well as Global deliverables, with reporting both locally and into the Global Program.
   

  

 Communication skills will be heavily utilized in forming and communicating a change agenda and gaining stakeholder buy\-in
   

  

 Help with ensuring Global Change Standards, Enterprise Procedures are followed for the project and that documentation meets Enterprise and line of business requirements.
   

  

 Help with managing project scope, timeline, and budget.
   

  

 Help with managing production of meeting decks and tracking meeting minutes and actions
   

  

 Help with managing RAID logs and follow up on open issues
   

  

 Ability to run testing calls, pick up issues and manage status reporting around defects.
   

  

 Experience of producing test metrics/MI for senior management
   

  

**Requirements**
**Education:** 
 Post\-graduate preferred
   

  

**Certifications If any** 
 : NA
   

  

**Experience Range** 
 : 3\-5 years
   

  

**Foundational skills:**
 A strong change management or transaction reporting experience is required, including the ability to prioritize work and meet deadlines and work in a highly matrixed organization
   

  

 Preference to candidates having prior experience in handling initiatives within regulatory/global markets space
   

  

 Strong verbal and written communication/presentation skills
   

  

 Eye for detail\- Ability to perform detailed requirements analysis and impact assessment across products/process/systems
   

  

 Experience of using appropriate tools and techniques to ensure efficient and effective requirements analysis, project/UAT status reporting and updates.
   

  

 Experience of the products and processes within Global Banking and Markets (FICC, Equities, Derivatives, FX \& Vanilla products, Asset services etc.) in a Global Bank or a consulting firm
   

  

 Familiarization with global regulatory frameworks and corresponding jurisdictional reporting obligations

 Strong end to end Project/UAT management skills, including the ability to prioritize work and meet deadlines and work in a highly matrixed organization. Construct detailed work plans, manage teams, achieve milestones, and communicate the result across a stakeholder audience

title: Tendering Specialist
company: DHRAX FORGE AND FITTINGS PRIVATE LIMITED
description:
**Company Description** 
 DHRAX FORGE AND FITTINGS PRIVATE LIMITED is a leading manufacturer and global exporter of premium flanges, forged fittings, and buttweld fittings for industrial piping systems. The company provides comprehensive solutions across a wide material range, from standard carbon steel to exotic alloys such as Inconel, Hastelloy, Titanium, Duplex, and specialty alloys. DHRAX serves demanding industries including oil and gas, petrochemical, power generation, chemical processing, marine and offshore, and construction. All products are manufactured to international standards (ASTM, ASME, ANSI, DIN), backed by custom manufacturing capabilities, rigorous quality control, and full material traceability. With a strong focus on reliability and quality, DHRAX supports global projects with consistent, on\-time delivery.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Tendering Specialist is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Chhatral, responsible for managing the end\-to\-end tendering and bidding process for industrial piping products and solutions. Day\-to\-day activities include identifying relevant tenders, reviewing tender documents, preparing compliant technical and commercial proposals, and coordinating with internal teams such as sales, engineering, and procurement to gather accurate data and pricing. The role involves analyzing client requirements, monitoring submission timelines, maintaining tender documentation, and ensuring that all bids meet regulatory, contractual, and company standards. The Tendering Specialist will also support post\-tender clarifications, participate in negotiations when required, and provide regular reporting on tender status, win/loss analysis, and market trends.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Tender Management skills, including end\-to\-end bid coordination, tender evaluation, and compliance with client and industry requirements.
* Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills to interpret technical specifications, pricing structures, and commercial terms, and to perform basic cost and margin analysis.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication and Proposal Writing skills to prepare clear tender documents, interact with clients, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams.
* Candidates should possess Procurement\-related skills, including coordination with suppliers, understanding of sourcing processes, and basic knowledge of pricing and contract terms.
* Relevant qualifications such as a bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, commerce, or a related field; experience in industrial products, piping systems, or manufacturing is preferred.
* Strong attention to detail, proficiency in MS Office (especially Excel and Word), and the ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Knowledge of international standards (ASTM, ASME, ANSI, DIN) and exposure to oil and gas, petrochemical, or related industries will be an advantage.

title: Application Expert- Drives & Automation
description:
**Job Title** 
 : Assistant Manager/Manager
 



  





**Location** 
 : Sanand, Gujarat
 



  





**Company** 
 : Hitachi Hi\-Rel Power Electronics Private Limited
 



  





**Position Overview** 
 : As the Senior Application Expert (LV Drives), the candidate will be the technical backbone of our new LV business vertical. Reporting directly to the Channel Sales Head, this role's primary mandate is to create technical "pull" in the market by converting complex engineering specifications at the consultant, OEM, and end\-user levels. The candidate will bridge the gap between sales and technology—equipping our internal regional sales team and our channel partners (System Integrators and Distributors) with the application expertise needed to win high\-value, application\-specific business. The candidate will be coordinating with HIES/HINC for application code / software development if required to support local team to apply carry forward same OEMs in India.
 



  





**Department:** 
 Sales \& Marketing
 



  





**Position Reporting to:** 
 Channel Sales Head\- Sales \& Marketing
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 Responsible for meeting the LV1 Module Technical Support:
 



 1\.Act as the subject matter expert (SME) for complex, heavy\-duty, and specialized LV VFD applications across industries (e.g., crane/hoist, tension control, multi\-drive systems, Compressors, Extruders, high\-speed pumps/fans, and HVAC systems, Machinery, Level 1 Automation).
 



 2\.Conduct joint technical visits with channel partners to key OEMs, Industrial End\-Users, and Automation Consultants to influence technical specifications in favour of our Japanese technology.
 



 3\.Analyze customer technical requirements, perform sizing, selection, and configuration of drives, and prepare robust, foolproof technical proposals. Troubleshoot complex application challenges during the pre\-sales phase to demonstrate product superiority and build customer confidence.
 



 4\.Design and deliver structured technical training programs, product certification courses, and application workshops for System Integrators (SIs), Value Added Resellers (VARs), and Distributors.
 



 5\.Create a self\-reliant channel ecosystem by empowering partner engineers to handle standard configurations and basic commissioning independently.
 



 6\.Provide continuous technical mentoring and application support to the internal team of 7–8 regional channel managers.
 



 7\.Perform deep technical benchmarking against key competitors (e.g., ABB, Siemens, Danfoss, Schneider, Fuji, Yaskawa Etc) to identify our product USPs and counter competitor arguments.
 



 8\.Develop localized application notes, success stories, and technical whitepapers to support the field sales team.
 



 Gather market intelligence on required product modifications, software features, or customized firmware, feeding this data back to the global Japanese R\&D and Product Management teams.
 



**Education Qualifications** 
 : B.E \- Electrical/ Instrumentation/ Electronics/EC/ Industrial Engg.
 



**Experience** 
 : Min. 10 years with min 6\-7 Yrs of strictly focus on LV Product Technical support across various industries
 



  





**Essential Knowledge \& skills:** 
 Experience of LV Drive Application knowledge in various fields, PLC programming, code writing, Good Presentation skills, Training ability
 



  





**Preferred Knowledge \& Skills:** 
 LV Drive market knowledge and product knowledge. Gujarati, Hindi and English language proficiency. Should be local resident, ready to travel across India.
